programme.title: WORLD OF TRAVEL [P13]
programme.desc: Kolyn Boyd and Lindsey Granger explore the transformation of Denver, Colorado, from a frontier legend to a modern cultural pioneer, discovering how old western grit meets new ambition in the place they call home. The journey begins in the shadow of the Rockies, where the hosts explore the 'Queen City of the Plains' and its history of constant reinvention. Guided by civic leaders including Mayor Mike Johnston, the episode explores Denver’s progressive legacy—from its early adoption of women's suffrage to its rise as a national innovation hub. The narrative also examines the city's modern 'green rush,' detailing how the 2014 legalization of marijuana transformed the state's economy, generating over $1.2 billion in tax revenue and creating a new frontier for medical and recreational tourism. The hosts pay homage to the area's first inhabitants, acknowledging that the land Denver sits on originally belonged to the Arapaho, Cheyenne, and Ute peoples. This cultural thread leads to the iconic Red Rocks Park and Amphitheatre, a geological wonder formed 300 million years ago and designated a National Historic Landmark. By tracing the city's history from ancient indigenous winter camping sites to world-renowned concert stages, the journey proves that the modern West is wiser, more inclusive, and still full of adventure.

programme.title: WORLD OF TRAVEL [P13]
programme.desc: Kolyn Boyd and Lindsey Granger journey from the ancient seaside ruins of Bodrum to the soaring, hand-carved peaks of Cappadocia to explore how the past finds new purpose in the bridge where western Asia meets eastern Europe. The journey begins on the Aegean coast in Bodrum, a city where ancient history catches the breeze through 15th-century windmills and the fortress of Bodrum Castle. Guided by local experts, the hosts explore the Myndos Gate, where the armies of Alexander the Great once clashed, and uncover the legacy of Princess Ada, one of the world's earliest female leaders. The episode highlights how these ancient spaces, including the grand marble theater, remain alive today as world-class venues for modern performance. The exploration then crosses east into Cappadocia, a landscape sculpted by fire and wind over millions of years. From the vantage point of a hot air balloon at sunrise, the team witnesses a bird's eye view of the region's famous fairy chimneys before descending into the Ozkonak Underground City—a nine-level subterranean complex built for ancient survival. The journey concludes at the Cappadocia Cave Suites, where the hosts meet the pioneering family who transformed their ancestral cave homes into a global tourism landmark, proving that Türkiye’s story is still being written by the people who walk its ancient paths.

programme.title: WORLD OF TRAVEL [P13]
programme.desc: Kolyn Boyd and Lindsey Granger dig beneath the postcard-perfect landscapes of Colorado to uncover a narrative of sacred homelands, the untold legacy of Black cowboys, and the rugged survival of mountain pioneers. The journey begins at the confluence of the South Platte River and Cherry Creek—the sacred heart of downtown Denver—where Rick Williams of People of Sacred Land reveals the 11,000-year history of the Cheyenne, Arapaho, and Ute nations. Facing the 'hard truths' of history, Mayor Mike Johnston discusses the city's commitment to recognition, including the creation of the first American Indian cultural embassy. The exploration continues at the Black American West Museum, where the hosts rediscover the 'lost brand' of the frontier: the Black cowboys and Exodusters who made up one in three cattle drivers in the Old West. Transitioning from the plains to the peaks, the team heads to Telluride and Winter Park to experience the evolution of mountain life. From the 19th-century 'Norwegian snowshoes' used by miners to high-speed snowmobile treks through the Silverton Caldera, the episode captures the adrenaline of the Rockies' gold-mining past. The journey concludes with a taste of the land, from traditional chokecherry puddings to a six-course Creole menu at The Tunnel—a modern speakeasy that honors the secret history of Prohibition-era Colorado.

From the 19th-century 'Norwegian snowshoes' used by miners to high-speed snowmobile treks through the Silverton Caldera, the episode captures the adrenaline of the Rockies' gold-mining past. The journey concludes with a taste of the land, from traditional chokecherry puddings to a six-course Creole menu at The Tunnel—a modern speakeasy that honors the secret history of Prohibition-era Colorado.

programme.title: ICE COLD KILLERS S4 [P13]
programme.desc: After karaoke, a nurse vanishes into a frigid Wisconsin night. Security footage shows her leaving with a mystery man. Detectives follow a chilling trail that ends with the revelation of a monstrous crime and a stolen life.

programme.title: WORLD OF TRAVEL [P13]
programme.desc: Kolyn Boyd and Lindsey Granger explore the transformation of Denver, Colorado, from a frontier legend to a modern cultural pioneer, discovering how old western grit meets new ambition in the place they call home. The journey begins in the shadow of the Rockies, where the hosts explore the 'Queen City of the Plains' and its history of constant reinvention. Guided by civic leaders including Mayor Mike Johnston, the episode explores Denver’s progressive legacy—from its early adoption of women's suffrage to its rise as a national innovation hub. The narrative also examines the city's modern 'green rush,' detailing how the 2014 legalization of marijuana transformed the state's economy, generating over $1.2 billion in tax revenue and creating a new frontier for medical and recreational tourism. The hosts pay homage to the area's first inhabitants, acknowledging that the land Denver sits on originally belonged to the Arapaho, Cheyenne, and Ute peoples. This cultural thread leads to the iconic Red Rocks Park and Amphitheatre, a geological wonder formed 300 million years ago and designated a National Historic Landmark. By tracing the city's history from ancient indigenous winter camping sites to world-renowned concert stages, the journey proves that the modern West is wiser, more inclusive, and still full of adventure.

programme.title: ARCHAEOLOGY [P13]
programme.desc: Twenty-five years ago, the ancient Mayans were thought to be a mysterious and peaceful people governed by astronomer-priests. But in 1965, Russian linguist Yuri Knorosov cracked the phonetic code of Mayan hieroglyphic writing in the confinements of his bustling Leningrad study. Today, researchers reveal stories of Mayan blood sacrifices as they uncover a world so foreign as to defy our understanding of it. From excavations deep in the jungles of Honduras to the most recent interpretations of hieroglyphic messages, researchers are unraveling the fascinating story of the rise and fall of the Mayans.

programme.title: CINTA SEPENUH JIWA EPS 109 [P13]
programme.desc: Lala is a young girl, the second daughter of Andi and Desi, who since childhood has carried enthusiasm and a smile with her every step. programme.title: The Presidents [P13]
programme.desc: Ronald Reagan, a charismatic leader, transformed America with Reaganomics, dividing opinion at home and abroad, and forever changing Conservatism with his visionary policies and iconic speeches.

programme.title: Keanu Reeves: The One And Only [P13]
programme.desc: The journey of Keanu Reeves, travel through his youth, his versatile filmography and his many emotinal peaks and troughs to uncover what makes this fantastic icon so celebrated.

programme.title: Aerial Africa [P13]
programme.desc: Explore the Western Cape's stunning shorelines, dramatic mountains, and richly-diverse metropolis, from thousands of feet in the air.

programme.title: Aerial Africa [P13]
programme.desc: Observe a land filled with geological phenomena whose majesty can only truly be appreciated from the sky. From forgotten shipwrecks strewn along the coastline to the unexplained fairy circles in Koakoveld, Namibia's secrets will be revealed.

programme.title: Mega Transports Specials [P13]
programme.desc: This giant magnet will revolutionize the world and energy production in the future. The world's largest nuclear fusion reactor is currently under construction in southern France.

programme.title: The Lost Tapes S2 [P13]
programme.desc: Rediscover the Tet Offensive: two months of battles that killed more than 15,000 American and Allied troops, and triggered anti-war protests across the U.S. Explore reports, images, and combat footage, much of which hasn’t been seen since 1968.

programme.title: The Lost Tapes S2 [P13]
programme.desc: Experience a chronological recounting of the Apollo 13 near-disaster, one of NASA’s most devastating—and finest—moments. Witness the events of April 1970 as they unfolded through news footage, mission control audio, and NASA archives.

programme.title: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild [P13]
programme.desc: Autumn is when stags compete to breed, osprey chicks begin a 3000-mile migration to West Africa, salmon return to the rivers where they were born and adders give birth to live young.

programme.title: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild [P13]
programme.desc: The winter is mild and wet, which is good news for some but bad news for others. Red deer are forced to higher ground, salmon have gone six months without food, mountain hares turn a conspicuous white, and squirrels kick their own young out of the nest.

programme.title: A New Zealand Food Story S4 [P13]
programme.desc: Ben takes a boat to visit a salmon farm in Akaroa and learns the difference between NZ King and Atlantic salmon. He catches salmon and cooks it on the shoreline overlooking the harbour. He checks out a high-quality homegrown culinary oil that’s both healthy and versatile, highlighting a commitment to local agriculture and sustainability.

programme.title: A New Zealand Food Story S4 [P13]
programme.desc: It’s stone fruit season! Ben visits a family run orchard in Central Otago known for its long season of stone fruit and a strong connection to the land and community. He discovers an all-electric cherry farm where premium export cherries are sold direct to Kiwis.

programme.title: A New Zealand Food Story S4 [P13]
programme.desc: Ben experiences the Ruapehu’s region emerging food story and rich history of market gardening. He meets a sixth generation farmer who has turned a remote wilderness into a thriving eco-tourism and fine dining destination, alongside an award winning chef.

programme.desc: On those hot, humid summer nights, nothing can get in the way of sleep like mosquitoes on the hunt. We learn about the tools the Edo townspeople had at their disposal to fight the pesky insects.

programme.title: NHK NEWSLINE

programme.title: Design X Stories
programme.desc: Today's theme: A New Look at Shadows. Japanese have long found beauty in shadows, but new discoveries still astonish us in art and design. Discover how these designs can change how we see the world.

programme.title: Rockie and Her Friends
programme.desc: Puppet action show for children. In a distant post-human future where surviving creatures have formed a community, new-breed dinosaur girl Rockie sets out on hilarious adventures with her schoolmates.

programme.title: TAKE TECH
programme.desc: A program for upper primary to lower secondary school children to explore the everyday technologies all around them. Each episode takes a piece of familiar tech to find out what it does and how.

programme.title: The Professionals: Rice Farmer
programme.desc: Seki Tomoharu once turned his back on farming; now he grows legendary rice that wins international awards. Why did he change? Amid rice shortages and global warming, he pursues his own green farming.

programme.desc: A gourmet tour of ramen all around Japan. This time: the birthplace of tonkotsu, Fukuoka. Looking at three different styles, we'll learn this ramen's secrets, and the story of its creation.

programme.title: BOSAI:Lava Flows
programme.desc: The hazard map for Mt. Fuji was revised in 2021, revealing the possibility of greater damage from lava flows. We'll look at what lies behind those assumptions and what countermeasures can be taken.

programme.title: DESIGN MUSEUM JAPAN
programme.desc: Sato Taku (Graphic designer) visits Miyazaki. The crowded signs of local bars inspire Sato to reconsider the conventions of modern design, and embrace the appeal of the unknown.

programme.title: KABUKI KOOL
programme.desc: The popular, but true story of two brothers who avenged their father inspired a dazzling variety of so many kabuki plays and dances. that they formed a new genre. Actor Ainosuke explores further.

programme.title: NHK NEWSLINE

programme.title: Bon Odori: Rhythm and Connection
programme.desc: The Bon Odori dance, a Japanese summer tradition, has gone global. We look at events held in Malaysia and Brazil and explore the rhythms that bring people from diverse backgrounds together.

programme.title: A Culture Built with Wood Kishu
programme.desc: Kishu, in the southern part of the Kii Peninsula, is famous among chefs worldwide for its charcoal production. Join us as we examine what fuels the eco-friendly charcoal culture of Kishu.

programme.title: Trails to Oishii Tokyo
programme.desc: The word yakumi refers to the use of traditional herbs and spices. Japanese food wouldn't be the same without favorites like wasabi or yuzu. See how these and more are influencing global food trends.

programme.title: Darwin's Amazing Animals

programme.title: BLOSSOM
programme.desc: Wang Ying Xue yang menggelapkan dana yang diperoleh daripada pinjaman wang haram dengan kerjasama daripada kumpulan perompak, telah ditangkap oleh ketua perompak kumpulan tersebut. Dia kemudian menghasut kumpulan perompak.

programme.title: GREAT TIMES
programme.desc: Shu Shu dan Huan Qi terserempak dengan Chee Qian dan Thian Yi di taman. Dia cemburu melihat kemesraan mereka lalu memberi amaran bahawa Thian Yi akan membawa musibah sekiranya dia menjadi menantu kepada Ruzhen.

programme.title: NO RETURN
programme.desc: Kwai-sim dinasihatkan meninggalkan Shanghai apabila pihak berkuasa Jepun akan membunuhnya. Kwai-sim datang ke Hong Kong bertemu dengan Shap-chat dan keluarga Wai Ho. Kini Kwai-sim sekali-sekala seolah-olah hilang ingatan.

programme.title: STAND OR FALL
programme.desc: Guan Wen percaya Tiberson boleh membantu menarik lebih ramai berkunjung ke Wanli dengan pengubahsuaian. Dia kemudian mengatur mesyuarat dengan Tiberson. Bagaimanapun, dia terpaksa pulang sebelum mesyuarat dimulakan.

programme.title: PROJECT LOVE SEASON 3 (CAPSULE)
programme.desc: Episod ini memaparkan kunjungan hos menemui Encik Wen, bekas pemandu lori yang diserang strok di Salak South. Ikuti kisah tabah isterinya serta usaha murni pertubuhan amal yang datang membersihkan rumah dan menyalurkan bantuan.

programme.title: PROJECT LOVE SEASON 3
programme.desc: 8TV’s heartfelt programme Project Love Season 3 returns with warmth and purpose!Continuing the mission of the first 2 seasons touching hearts through real stories,Project Love Season 3 steps even closer into the everyday lives of ordinary Malaysians.

programme.title: TILL THE END OF THE MOON
programme.desc: Xiwu yang terjatuh ke dalam Sungai Hitam, menemui sebuah jed ajaib dan terselamat. Dia menemui Tai Jin terbaring tidak sedarkan diri di kawasan hutan, ketika dalam perjalanan untuk pulang ke wilayah Sheng.

programme.title: TILL THE END OF THE MOON
programme.desc: Xiwu terserempak dengan Pian Ran dalam perjalanan untuk pulang ke tanah airnya. Dengan bimbingan Pian Ran, dia menuju ke sebuah jurang fantasi menghalangnya daripada berubah menjadi raja iblis.

programme.title: TREASURE HUNT IN MALAYSIA 3
programme.desc: Episod ini dua orang hos bersama dua orang tetamu jemputan yang merupakan hos TV dibahagikan kepada dua kumpulan untuk mengambil bahagian dalam siri permainan di Eagle Ranch Resort, Port Dickson.

programme.title: PROUD OF YOU (301-600)
programme.desc: Kimura Kenji membawa Shengyuan, Ziting dan Zixian ke bilik hotel untuk bertemu dengan Wenxue. Kimura Kenji menunjukkan klip video tentang Jialiang dan Wenxue datang ke hotel itu. Dia juga mendakwa Wenxue hamil dan siapa ayahnya.

programme.title: PROUD OF YOU (301-600)
programme.desc: San Hao dan Thong menolak cadangan Vincent untuk membeli saham dalam Hao Jie Logistics. Vincent kemudian bercadang untuk membeli satu produk milik San Hao yang berkaitan dengan Yitonggao dan dipersetujui.

programme.title: GREAT TIMES
programme.desc: Ruguan gembira dia dapat menghalang Shu Shu daripada menggoda Huan Qi. Jia Ming marah apabila ternampak Chee Kan dan Ruo Lan bersama di dalam bilik hospital untuk menjaga Toto.

programme.title: THE LEGEND OF TAIWAN 17
programme.desc: Yi Loong dan Jin Hu adalah kawan rapat dan kedua-duanya miskin. Yi Loong seorang yang jujur, baik hati dan mempunyai sifat yang adil manakala Jin Hu seorang oportunis. Mereka berdua selalu ditipu oleh majikan mereka.

programme.title: MY ONE AND ONLY
programme.desc: Renpin enggan menerima keputusan Jingjing, manakala Haojian dan Huiling bergilir-gilir menjaga Limin yang demam. Sementara itu, Zhongyi mendapati May memalsukan kecederaannya, dan Yurou meminta bantuan Haojian akibat diganggu.

programme.title: LOVE LIKE THE GALAXY
programme.desc: Cheng Shi, ketua keluarga Cheng, dan isterinya Xiao Yuan Yi yang bertahun-tahun di medan perang dalam perjalanan pulang membawa kejayaan tapi anak perempuan tunggal mereka, Cheng Shao Shang kini dalam situasi membimbangkan.

programme.title: LOVE LIKE THE GALAXY
programme.desc: Apabila pulang ke rumah, penampilan Shao Shang tidak dipandang serius terutama oleh neneknya yang sentiasa bersaing dengannya untuk mendapat perhatian anaknya, Cheng Shi. Shao Shang tidak mahu dia diabaikan seperti ibunya.

programme.title: LOVE VIRTUALLY
programme.desc: Cheng Cheng dikurung oleh Dan dan Natasha selepas dipaksa menyerahkan teknologi pemindahan segera demi mencuri dana kebajikan. Dengan bantuan Adam, Cheng Cheng berjaya melepaskan diri dan merancang helah untuk melaga-lagakan pasangan itu.

programme.title: CAHAYA KAMPUNG BARU
programme.desc: Episod ini memaparkan pengembaraan ke Kampung Baru Manchis untuk bertemu pengasas Kumpulan LKE yang memiliki ladang eko-pelancongan durian premium. Terokai keunikan LKE Space, inap desa, serta program anak angkat pokok durian.

programme.title: YES! NIGHT MARKET
programme.desc: Episod ini tiga orang hos dibantu dua selebriti jemputan akan menjual bebola ubi dan "cong you bing" di sebuah taman permainan di Jepun untuk diberikan kepada pengunjung bagi mendapat maklum balas mengenai rasa dan harga jualan.

programme.title: HEALING HEROES
programme.desc: Ah Sheng merayu ibunya Cai Yan untuk membantunya memikat hati Suk Fen semula. Megan tidak dapat tidur lena pada waktu malam kerana diganggu oleh Cai Ruan. Hao Nan mencadangkan agar dia berpindah ke biliknya.

programme.title: HEALING HEROES
programme.desc: Ke Lun dan Jia Cai yang terserempak di sebuah taman tema, melakukan CPR untuk seorang lelaki yang pengsan secara tiba-tiba. Ren Hui yang melawat Cai Ruan di rumah, terpaksa tenangkan Megan yang tertekan semasa menjaga Cai Ruan.

programme.title: GLOWING EMBERS
programme.desc: Ma-Kor seorang samseng tempatan ingin merekrut Fei-Long sebagai ahli kumpulannya. Tindakan Fei-Long menolak ajakannya mendapat kepujian Ah-Soon, ahli kumpulan Ma-Kor. Fei-Long sentiasa menolong orang tua di kawasan perumahannya.

programme.title: UTUSAN CINTA BUAT ADAM
programme.desc: Aireen dan ibunya berubat ke Acheh dan hanya tinggalkan surat kepada Adam. Adam nyaris putus asa dan mahu menerima cinta Adura. Liyana rasa bersalah dan dia mengaku kepada Adam dia yang menjadikan Aireen sakit teruk.

programme.title: GLOWING EMBERS
programme.desc: Set against a unique and little known business of charcoal production, viewers will revisit Small Town Peninsular Malaysia amidst mangrove swamps, muddy shores and charcoal kilns and watch the story of Fei Long, a young male protagonist.

programme.title: Pesona 10-2
programme.desc: Pendengar berpeluang memberi ucapan kepada orang yang tersayang dan membuat permintaan lagu menerusi ruangan Laguku Untukmu, bermula jam 11 pagi. Turut disajikan rancangan Dialog 1:30, program temu bual bersama Jabatan Kerajaan dan agensi-agensi berkaitan dengan memfokuskan topik-topik berkaitan situasi semasa. Rancangan keagamaan seperti Mutiara Ilmu, Fiqh Nisa dan Dari Kamar Syariah pula diserikan pada setiap Jumaat.

programme.title: Panorama 2-5
programme.desc: Santai bersama lagu-lagu tempatan dan antarabangsa terbaik menerusi ruangan 'Zon Muzik setiap Isnin jam 3 petang. Pada setiap Selasa, info-info menarik mengenai kenderaan dikongsikan menerusi rancangan 'Vromm??'. Pendengar juga akan menikmati keindahan warisan budaya negeri Melaka menerusi 'Dondang Sayang' jam 3 petang, Rabu dan 'Persada Pantun' jam 3 petang, Khamis. Turut disajikan rancangan keagamaan seperti 'Secangkir Bicara: Biar Santai Janji Sampai' dan 'Nurul Quran' \"La khobar\"pada setiap Jumaat. Sabtu dan Ahad diserikan dengan Silang Budaya/Stesen Berkembar Suara Bertemu Suara Satu Suara Satu Jiwa.

Seleksi lagu-lagu ketuhanan melayari Khamis malam Jumaat anda. Turut Hangatkan malam Isnin anda dengan seleksi lagu terbaik menerusi 'Janji Rock' bersama DJ Lia. programme.title: SEGMEN HARMONIKA (1700-1900)
programme.desc:
Harmonika merupakan segmen siaran petang ke malam KENINGAUfm yang menekankan keharmonian emosi, muzik dan kehidupan. Bersiaran dari jam 5 hingga 7 malam, segmen ini menjadi pengiring setia pendengar ketika waktu pulang dari kerja, dalam perjalanan, atau berehat bersama keluarga menjelang malam.

Segmen ini menyajikan lagu-lagu malar segar, balada, nostalgia dan pilihan pendengar yang menenangkan jiwa, diselang-selikan dengan perkongsian santai, refleksi ringan dan kisah kehidupan yang menyentuh perasaan. 

Harmonika turut membuka ruang interaksi dua hala melalui dedikasi lagu, kiriman mesej dan ucapan daripada pendengar, menjadikan segmen ini dekat dan peribadi. Di samping hiburan, segmen ini menyelitkan kata-kata positif, nilai kekeluargaan dan mesej kemanusiaan, sesuai untuk menutup hari dengan rasa damai dan seimbang.

Segmen ini bukan sekadar hiburan muzik, tetapi sebuah ruang harmoni yang menyatukan perasaan, kenangan dan harapan pendengar dalam alunan petang menuju malam.

programme.title: SEGMEN RENTAK SEGAR (0600-0900)
programme.desc: Segmen Rentak Segar – Permulaan Hari dengan Energi Positif di KENINGAUfm! Rentak Segar merupakan segmen siaran Bahasa Malaysia yang membuka tirai pagi di KENINGAUfm, bersiaran setiap hari dari pukul 6:00 hingga 9:00 pagi. Segmen ini menjadi pilihan utama pendengar di pedalaman Sabah untuk memulakan hari dengan maklumat terkini, hiburan, dan motivasi pagi yang segar.

programme.title: SEGMEN DUSUN-KUHOI ARAMAI BOH (0900-1200)
programme.desc: Kuhoi Aramai Boh merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Dusun yang bersifat ceria, mesra komuniti dan sarat nilai budaya, disiarkan setiap pagi dari jam 9 hingga 12 tengah hari. Segmen ini menjadi ruang kebersamaan untuk pendengar berkongsi cerita, gelak tawa, dan maklumat bermanfaat dalam suasana santai seperti berkumpul sesama keluarga.\n\nSepanjang tempoh siaran, pendengar disajikan dengan lagu-lagu Dusun dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berunsur hiburan, motivasi dan kehidupan seharian, serta perkongsian isu komuniti setempat. Interaksi langsung bersama pendengar melalui panggilan telefon, WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu mengukuhkan hubungan dua hala antara penyampai dan komuniti.

programme.title: SEGMEN MURUT- PAGAYAMAN TAKAW MONSOI (1200-1500)
programme.desc:
Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Murut yang mengangkat semangatperkongsian dan kebersamaan yang harmoni bersama komuniti. Bersiaran setiap hari dari jam 12 hingga 3 petang.

Segmen ini mengetengahkan lagu-lagu Murut dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berkenaan kehidupan harian, budaya, adat resam serta kisah komuniti pedalaman, di samping perkongsian maklumat semasa yang dekat dengan realiti pendengar. 

Interaksi dua hala menjadi kekuatan utama Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi melalui panggilan telefon, pesanan WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu, sekali gus memberi ruang kepada pendengar untuk bersuara, berkongsi cerita dan menyampaikan salam kekeluargaan. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata nasihat, nilai murni dan mesej kemasyarakatan, menjadikannya bukan sahaja menghiburkan, malah menyatukan dan memperkukuh jati diri komuniti dikawasan Pedalaman.

programme.title: SEGMEN SANTAI PETANG (1500-1700)
programme.desc:
Santai Petang merupakan segmen siaran yang menemani pendengar KENINGAUfm pada waktu peralihan dari rutin kerja ke suasana petang yang lebih tenang. Bersiaran dari jam 3 hingga 5 petang, segmen ini membawa pendekatan santai, ringan dan menghiburkan, sesuai dinikmati ketika dalam perjalanan pulang, berehat di rumah atau masih di tempat kerja.

Segmen ini menghidangkan lagu-lagu pilihan tempatan dan popular, diselang-selikan dengan sembang santai, perkongsian kisah harian, isu ringan semasa, serta topik-topik dekat dengan kehidupan pendengar.

Interaksi bersama pendengar menjadi elemen utama Santai Petang, melalui kiriman WhatsApp, dedikasi lagu dan respons spontan terhadap pandangan pendengar. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata motivasi ringkas, info bermanfaat dan mesej positif, menjadikan ia bukan sekadar hiburan, tetapi juga ruang untuk melepaskan tekanan dan menutup hari dengan emosi yang lebih baik.

programme.title: SEGMEN HARMONIKA (1700-1900)
programme.desc:
Harmonika merupakan segmen siaran petang ke malam KENINGAUfm yang menekankan keharmonian emosi, muzik dan kehidupan. Bersiaran dari jam 5 hingga 7 malam, segmen ini menjadi pengiring setia pendengar ketika waktu pulang dari kerja, dalam perjalanan, atau berehat bersama keluarga menjelang malam.

Segmen ini menyajikan lagu-lagu malar segar, balada, nostalgia dan pilihan pendengar yang menenangkan jiwa, diselang-selikan dengan perkongsian santai, refleksi ringan dan kisah kehidupan yang menyentuh perasaan. 

Harmonika turut membuka ruang interaksi dua hala melalui dedikasi lagu, kiriman mesej dan ucapan daripada pendengar, menjadikan segmen ini dekat dan peribadi. Di samping hiburan, segmen ini menyelitkan kata-kata positif, nilai kekeluargaan dan mesej kemanusiaan, sesuai untuk menutup hari dengan rasa damai dan seimbang.

Segmen ini bukan sekadar hiburan muzik, tetapi sebuah ruang harmoni yang menyatukan perasaan, kenangan dan harapan pendengar dalam alunan petang menuju malam.
